SOLVE SHARD ucmiso-vlr-v-2019 — MISO backcast year 2019, ONE year, ONE container (rule 36). Model: Opus.
DATA PROFILE: miso

HARD STOPS — check each FIRST; if any fails, STOP and report (do not push, do not repair):
1. `git rev-parse HEAD` == 3a55fa75ba10c62f38a3038367ed6a31f583859a  (never pull, rebase, merge or "sync"; a SHA cannot be raced)
2. `python3 scripts/prepare_solve_container.py` — FIRST, before any data step (R-50: swap is bounded by free disk, and the data steps below eat it); report its `before:` and `swap:` lines
3. `python3 scripts/hydrate_data.py --profile miso` then `python3 scripts/regenerate_clean.py --solve-profile MISO` (if that flag is absent at this SHA, run `python3 scripts/regenerate_clean.py`); both exit 0
4. the recipe you will solve: `results/calibration/closeout_miso_nuc_span` replayed with unit_commitment_milp=true, st_gas_mustrun_per_plant=false, vlr_pocket_commitment=true; confirm by reading `results/calibration/closeout_miso_nuc_span/run_config.json` and `meta.json` — the config signature the parent expects: unit_commitment_milp=true; st_gas_mustrun_per_plant=false; vlr_pocket_commitment=true
5. memory: the runner calls `scripts/lib/solve_container.ensure_solve_container` itself; never pass `--no-container-preflight`, never read `free` — report the `container preflight:` and `memory peak:` log lines

SOLVE (sequential, this year only):
  eval "$(python3 scripts/prepare_solve_container.py --emit-exports)"
  python3 scripts/replay_keeper.py results/calibration/closeout_miso_nuc_span --years 2019 --out-dir results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019 --set unit_commitment_milp=true --set st_gas_mustrun_per_plant=false --set vlr_pocket_commitment=true --note "ucmiso-vlr: arm V (UC, ST_GAS per-plant floor off, VLR pocket commitment on)"
Budget: 180 minutes of wall clock for the LP. At the budget with no bundle written: STOP and report; never push a half-written bundle (rule 27).

PUSH THE WHOLE BUNDLE (rule 34 (a) — a bundle that cannot back a promotion is a wasted solve):
  git checkout -b claude/ucmiso-vlr-v-2019
  printf '\n!results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/**\n' >> .gitignore
  git add .gitignore && git add results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019
  git status --short      # MUST show nothing outside .gitignore and results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019
  git commit -m "ucmiso-vlr-v: MISO 2019 leg (results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019)"
  git push -u origin claude/ucmiso-vlr-v-2019     # on HTTP 408/500: git config http.version HTTP/1.1, retry
`results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/dispatch/2019_P1.parquet` MUST be in the pushed tree (`git ls-tree -r HEAD -- results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/dispatch`). A plain `git add` after the .gitignore negation — never `git add -f`, never `git add -A`, never `git add .`.

FORBIDDEN, by name: git add -A / git add . ; any edit under src/ or scripts/ ; dashboard_add_run.py, build_manifest.py, build_status.py, prune_iso_runs.py, promote_keeper.py, anything under frontend/data/ (registration is the parent's job, once) ; opening a PR ; deleting any result (rule 31) ; solving any other year.

REPORT in your final message, in numbers: HEAD sha; the `container preflight:` and `memory peak:` lines; LP wall time; for 2019: objective, total generation TWh by class, mean and p99 price per zone, unserved energy MWh; the commit sha and branch; `git ls-tree` count under results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019; and any hard stop that fired. A shard that stops with a clear report is a SUCCESS; a shard that repairs infrastructure is a FAILURE.

ADDENDUM (lane UC-MISO-VLR arm V, PRECOMMIT docs/records/miso/ucmilp/PRECOMMIT-ucmiso-vlr-2026-10-15.md on branch claude/uc-miso-vlr; engine uc-1.6 + VLR pocket rows):
- STEP 0, before hard stop 2: if `.venv` is absent run `uv sync` (the only install route; never pip install), and run EVERY python step in this prompt as `uv run python3 …`. `uv.lock` must not change.
- MEMORY GATE (hard stop 2b): from prepare_solve_container's `swap:` line read ceiling + swap total. If it is below 22.4 GiB, STOP before any data step and report the `before:` and `swap:` lines verbatim. Do not solve on a smaller container (arm B lost 2023-25 to OOM at 16.4-17.4 GiB).
- hard stop 3b: after regenerate_clean, `ls data/clean/vlr-pocket-groups/MISO/` must show a parquet (19 rows) and `data/clean/uc-params/MISO/` must exist. Either absent = STOP and report.
- RUN THE SOLVE DETACHED: `nohup setsid uv run python3 scripts/replay_keeper.py <the SOLVE line's arguments, unchanged> > /tmp/solve_2019.log 2>&1 &` (same shell, after the `eval "$(…--emit-exports)"` line), then poll the log (`tail`, `grep -c "UC window"`) every few minutes until the process exits; record its exit code. Also paste the log's `VLR pocket requirement:` line verbatim.
- ENGINE CHECKS (Addendum 0; any failure = recipe break: report, push nothing): in results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/uc_solve_log_2019.json, `engine.fields.vlr_pocket_commitment` is true; `engine.vlr_pocket.sets` has exactly 4 entries labelled "Amite South:A", "DSG:B", "Western:F", "WOTAB:D+WOTAB:E" with n_req 1, 1, 1, 2; `engine.vlr_pocket.unmatched_groups` == ["WOTAB:C"]; every `windows[].pocket_rows` > 0 and every `windows[].pocket_sets_skipped` == 0. Paste `engine.vlr_pocket` verbatim.
- also confirm hourly/uc_schedule_2019.parquet, hourly/uc_uplift_2019.parquet, uc_solve_log_2019.json and hourly/unit_marginal_2019.parquet are in the pushed tree (`git ls-tree -r HEAD -- results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/hourly results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/uc_solve_log_2019.json`). The UC gate armed but no uc_schedule_2019.parquet written = HARD STOP: report, do not push.
- FILES > 100 MB: split before commit, do not stop and do not ask: for each such file f, `sha256sum f > f.SHA256`; `split -b 95m -d f f.part-`; `sha256sum f.part-* >> f.SHA256`; move f out of the tree (`mv f /tmp/`), then `git add` the parts and f.SHA256 with everything else. Never `git add -f`. Report every split file with its whole-file sha256.
- the keeper's recipe is PER YEAR (2023-2025 add miso_measured_reserve_requirements=true and miso_reserve_online_gated=true; every year its own gas_price_override / weather_year / gas_offer_margin_anchor). replay_keeper.py --years 2019 applies them; pass nothing extra. After the solve, paste from results/calibration/ucmiso_vlr_v_2019/run_config*.json: gas_price_override, weather_year, gas_offer_margin_anchor, unit_commitment_milp, st_gas_mustrun_per_plant, vlr_pocket_commitment (and for 2023-2025 the two reserve flags).
- report: the `log_year_phase_timing` line verbatim, the `UC stage prepared:` line verbatim, the `summary` object of uc_solve_log_2019.json verbatim, `engine.version`, `engine.integer_set_size`, the count of non-optimal windows, P1 unserved MWh and dump MWh. The parent computes ratios and verdicts; do not judge them.
- an OOM kill (rc -9), a UC hard stop (infeasible window, 'no incumbent') or a P1 with no feasible primal after the UC stage is a SUCCESSFUL report: paste the preflight lines, the exception verbatim and the last 20 `UC window` lines; push nothing; stop. Never relaunch with a changed setting.
- never edit any uc_* or vlr_* field, never pass another --set, never re-run with a different time limit.
